# JPMorganChase expands support for Bay Area entrepreneurs


Chase for Business CEO Stevie Baron appeared on LIVE! In the Bay to talk about how the firm is supporting Bay Area entrepreneurs through its American Dream Initiative.


October 8, 2026

For many entrepreneurs, a great idea is only the beginning, turning it into a thriving business takes the right resources, guidance and access to opportunity.


Chase for Business is expanding its investment in Bay Area entrepreneurs through its American Dream Initiative, including free one-on-one coaching and increased access to capital.


[Chase for Business](http://chase.com/business) CEO Stevie Baron, along with[Cowrie Collective](https://cowriecosf.com/) member and Belle Noire founder Nicole Williams shared how it all works with host Jessica Wills.
